synergy: Araquanid sets Sticky Web to slow foes, protecting fast sweepers like Cinderace and Kingambit; Dragonite and Iron Treads provide strong physical coverage and entry hazards; Pecharunt offers special sweeping with Nasty Plot and Tera Blast; overall team balances speed, bulk, and coverage.
suggestions: Add a dedicated status user (e.g., Toxtricity) to support Araquanid and Pecharunt; consider a faster, more reliable sweeper like Dragapult to finish off weakened foes; replace Iron Treads’ Rapid Spin with a move like Knock Off for better utility; give Dragonite a powerful coverage move such as Outrage or Dragon Claw; give Pecharunt a faster move like Sludge Wave for better matchup against faster threats.
